mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 44 degrees near the Verona Public Library with a waning crescent moon overhead.

Public works announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11 near Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street, plus the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to discuss development projects at the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in town with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, the Dane County Farmers' Market happening tomorrow, and various trivia nights and yoga classes scheduled throughout next week.

In a report regarding notable calls for service, on October 25, officers arrested a man for operating while intoxicated after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at the corner of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day; they are open until 10:30 PM tonight so there is plenty of time to satisfy your sweet tooth.
